title: Need Testers
author: Friendly_Fault_9753
selftext: Hi. Anyone interesting in helping me test my game and provide feedback? Hits Inc is a music career simulation game, inspired by The Road To Success. I would appreciate feedback. I built this on Lovable. Here is the link: [https://hitsincgame.com](https://hitsincgame.com)

replies.author: PGF_Hardwell
replies.body: can't even log into it. also why you need a Google account for this?

replies.author: Friendly_Fault_9753
replies.body: Thank you for sharing this. I will look into it.

replies.author: Friendly_Fault_9753
replies.body: I have sorted this issue out.

replies.author: PGF_Hardwell
replies.body:
24 hours to create a song is wild.
that's 48 real minutes of waiting...

replies.author: Friendly_Fault_9753
replies.body: Than you for the feedback. The goal was to make the music industry feel more realistic instead of instant progression. But I hear the concern about pacing. I’m probably going to rebalance early-game recording times and add more activities while songs are being made so the wait feels more engaging rather than blocking gameplay.
